title: Extension from unit finite comparison formula
statement:
theorem finite_formula_of_unit
    (bfin : ∀ n : ℕ,
      (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).ι ⋙ finiteLeft l E L ι g n ≅
        (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).ι ⋙ finiteRight l E L ι g n)
    (hunit : FiniteFormulaUnit l E L ι g bfin) :
    FiniteFormula l E L ι g bfin

proof.text: Use tensor-product balancing and linearity of the sheafification unit to prove that the ordinary reduction tensor with coefficient a is a times its unit tensor, and that finitePure(s,a*x)=q(a)*finitePure(s,x). Transport these equalities through the actual module identifications defining the tensor sections.

Naturality of the constant-sheaf coefficient comparison for the quotient-ring homomorphism shows inv(c_L)(q_X(c_E(a)))=q_Y(a). The inverse-image module action is restriction along inv(c_E), so c_E(a) acts on the pulled-back unit reduction tensor as a.

Apply the finite comparison component, which is a morphism of finite L-coefficient modules, to the balanced tensor. Move q_X(c_E(a)) through this linear map and use the assumed unit formula. The preceding coefficient-transport equality and scalar linearity of integralScalarTensorSection yield the required coefficient inv(c_L)(s)*q_Y(a), using commutativity.
